object.description: Open the req-test fixture repository, which holds the documents VCU3-SyRS, VCU3-SRS and VCU3-STS. Expected: the document list holds exactly those three document IDs. Then open a repository with the documents DOC and PARENT in which DOC's only object file holds git conflict markers. Expected: DOC and PARENT are both listed; DOC's row says it failed to load, its tooltip names DOC-1.xml with a line number and '(unresolved merge conflict?)', and the status bar says 1 failed to load.
